records.title: Prescription Behavior Measure -- Drug-to-Indication-to-ICD10 Mapping Design
records.description: Design for mapping provider prescription data to on-label FDA indications with ICD-10 codes, tied to recognized CMS/NQF quality measures. Two implementation paths under evaluation: static reference dataset or LLM-generated mapping with cache.

data_sources.prescriptions: CMS Medicare Part D Public Use Files (data.cms.gov) -- provider NPI + drug + quantity
data_sources.drug_indications: TBD: DailyMed SPL, FDA Orange Book, RxNorm, or LLM-generated mapping
data_sources.icd10: ICD-10-CM code set (icd10_loader.py already in pipeline)
data_sources.quality_measures: NQF quality measures, CMS Quality IDs (e.g., NQF 0018 / CMS 236)

uses.qualityMeasureContext: Adult BP control measure (e.g., NQF 0018 / CMS Quality ID 236 -- Controlling High Blood Pressure)

drugName.description: Brand or generic name of the drug

uses.description: Array of on-label FDA-approved uses, constrained to how they are recognized for this quality measure

indication.description: Clinical description of the on-label indication as applied in this quality measure

qualityMeasureContext.description: Name/identifier of the quality measure this mapping is intended for (e.g., NQF ID, CMS Quality ID)

icd10Codes.description: ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes that qualify as this condition for the quality measure denominator/logic

relevance.description: Does the provider prescribing pattern indicate they treat the patient condition?
relevance.method: Map provider top drugs -> on-label indications -> ICD-10 -> compare to patient condition

integrity.description: Does the prescribing pattern show red flags for fraud or inappropriate prescribing?
integrity.method: Controlled substance ratio vs specialty peers, prescribing outside specialty scope, anomaly detection

path_a.name: Static reference dataset
path_a.source: DailyMed SPL, FDA Orange Book, or RxNorm
path_a.con: Requires finding and licensing the dataset, ETL pipeline to keep current

path_b.name: LLM-generated mapping with cache
path_b.source: GPT or Haiku generates drug-indication-ICD10 mapping on demand
path_b.pro: No dataset dependency, covers any drug immediately
path_b.con: LLM output not verified, hallucination risk on clinical data, per-call cost
path_b.decision: TBD -- acceptable for alpha, close in beta with verified source

records.alpha_gap: Drug-to-indication mapping source not finalized. LLM fallback acceptable for alpha. Close in beta with verified mapping table.
records.patent_relevance: Method of combining CMS prescriber data + ICD-10 + drug indication mapping + quality measure context + LLM synthesis for consumer provider quality signal. Data is public. Method is novel.

records.title: County Economic Enrichment Design
records.description: Enrich provider county attribute with GDP, income, rural/urban classification from public federal data sources.

data_sources.census_acs: api.census.gov ACS 5-year: B19013 (median income), B19025 (mean income). By county FIPS.
data_sources.bea_gdp: apps.bea.gov CAGDP2: county GDP by industry. By county FIPS.
data_sources.usda_rucc: ers.usda.gov Rural-Urban Continuum Codes 2023. CSV, maps FIPS to 1-9 metro/rural scale.

schema.county.gdp_millions: float -- county GDP in millions USD

records.title: Agent Framework Architecture Design
records.description: Shared agent framework for all ChatHealthy AI agents. BaseAgent, BaseTool, ToolRegistry. Extensible without refactor.

agents.ops_manager: Pipeline infrastructure lifecycle. Tools: ClusterTool, CostTool, AlertTool, ScheduleTool.
agents.research_agent: External data research. Tools: WebSearchTool, PubMedTool, CTGovTool, FDATool.
agents.db_agent: Database management. Tools: QueryTool, IndexTool, BackupTool, MigrateTool.

base_classes.BaseAgent: Code/Shared/agent_framework/base_agent.py — has ToolRegistry, handles events, decides, acts or escalates
base_classes.BaseTool: Code/Shared/agent_framework/base_tool.py — execute(), can_handle_error(), repair(). Standard ToolResult.
base_classes.ToolRegistry: Code/Shared/agent_framework/tool_registry.py — allowlist (GOV-004). Agent only calls registered tools.
base_classes.ToolResult: Standard result: success, data, error_code, is_infrastructure_error, is_pipeline_error

records.event_flow: Timer/API/Error -> Agent.handle_event() -> pick tool -> execute -> success or escalate

error_routing.infrastructure_error: Ops Manager attempts self-repair via repair tool. If fails, escalates to Boss.
error_routing.pipeline_error: Escalates to Dev Manager (Claude). Ops Manager does not diagnose pipeline errors.
error_routing.unknown_error: Escalates to Boss with full context.

records.governance: GOV-004 enforced via ToolRegistry. Agent suggests tool, registry decides if allowed. Boss is final escalation.

versioning.v01: Rule-based decisions. Ops Manager with ClusterLifecycleTool only.
versioning.v02: AI-powered triage. LLM reads error context, decides repair vs escalate.
versioning.v03: Multi-agent coordination. Ops Manager + Research Agent + DB Agent.

implementation.reservation_model: Array in MongoDB. Multiple concurrent. Last release shuts down cluster.

records.title: GUI Manager — Frame Layout and Control Surface Design
records.description: Parent page frame layout with GUI Manager control surface. All dimensions percentage-based. Left and right panels start at 1%, can expand to push center content. Control frame is a 7% canvas that renders controls on demand via postMessage.

left_panel.behavior: Expands to push center content. Future: navigation, sidebar.
left_panel.notes: Allows entire interface to shift right at will.

chat_iframe.width: fills between left and right panels

control_frame.content: Empty canvas. Controls appear when needed (pagination, filters, future widgets). Blank otherwise.
control_frame.behavior: React app sends HTML via postMessage (gui:render). Parent renders into this div. Clicks relay back to React app via postMessage (gui:event). When controls are cleared (gui:clear), the canvas goes blank but stays visible at 7%.

right_panel.behavior: Expands when leaf page opens (architecture, roadmap, design docs). Retracts when closed.
right_panel.current_impl: legal-panel class — needs refactor from fixed overlay to inline flex panel

flow: 2. Tool counts total, returns first N records + total_count
3. Claude tells user: 'Here are the first N of TOTAL. Would you like to see more?'
4. NO controls yet. Client stores search state silently (pendingPaginationRef).
5. User says 'yes' (any message while pagination is pending)
6. Frontend fetches page 2 via /search directly — NO LLM round-trip
8. User pages forward/back via control buttons — all deterministic, no LLM
9. User sends new chat message — controls disappear, state cleared

button_states.back_at_beginning: Disabled, tooltip: 'You are at the beginning'
button_states.forward_at_end: Disabled, tooltip: 'You are at the end'

pagination.button_style: 3D raised buttons. Cold gray (blue-tinted) at rest. Warm gray (stone) when pressed. Mouse down depresses with inset shadow. Mouse up returns to raised.
pagination.api_endpoint: /search — direct provider search, no LLM, deterministic
rules: LLM never sees fetch_all or after_npi — those fields are not in the tool definition
LLM always gets total_count in tool result and must report it to user
System prompt RULE 9 tells Claude to present first page and ask 'would you like to see more?'
Controls only appear after user opts in and second page renders
All pagination after first page is deterministic — /search with after_npi, no LLM

gui_manager.state_ownership: All state lives in React. Parent page is a stateless rendering surface.

backlog.title: Leaf page control — more control over right panel behavior
backlog.notes: Boss directive: add to GUI Manager. Not further defined yet.

rules: All dimensions in percentages, no pixels
Left and right panels are always present (1% minimum)
Control frame is always visible at 7% — blank canvas when no controls active
Chat iframe fills remaining vertical space in center column
React app owns all state — parent page is a dumb rendering surface
Controls appear and disappear via postMessage — no page reloads

records.title: Pipeline Architecture v4 -- Bulletproof ETL

boss_requirements.target: Bulletproof ETL -- 95% successful end-to-end runs when source files exist
boss_requirements.fatal_alert: Ring bell continuously every 5 seconds on Boss computer for fatal errors

v3_retained: Parquet canonical intermediate format (ADLS Gen2, pyarrow, zstd)
Dual logging (ADLS commit log + MongoDB checkpoint)
Circuit breakers, dead-letter queues, rate limiters
Chunk-level state machine (pending -> in_progress -> complete -> verified | failed)

provider_pipeline.description: Full NPPES provider data load, enrichment, embedding, and ship to frontend
provider_pipeline.data_source: NPPES (CMS) -- 10.6GB ZIP, all US healthcare providers

steps.name: Download NPI ZIP
steps.notes: Auto-discovers URL from CMS page, ETag/SHA-256 skip guard, 8MB stream chunks to Azure Blob

steps.name: Extract CSV to blob
steps.notes: Skip guard if CSV already exists in blob

steps.name: Compute byte-aligned partitions
steps.notes: Newline-aligned boundaries from blob byte ranges, O(1) memory (DR-008)

steps.name: Write worker metadata
steps.notes: One record per worker in admin.DataLoadMetadata

steps.name: Fan-out load
steps.notes: 32 workers load partitions simultaneously via task_all

steps.name: Build indexes + reconcile counts
steps.notes: Parallel: post-load indexes + source vs loaded count verification

stage_4_embed.notes: Pre-filter excludes bad_data/out_of_scope. Rate limiting with exponential backoff + jitter. DR-022: embed on pipeline cluster only, never frontend.

stage_5_ship.method: Partition via $bucketAuto (DR-008), copy by _id range in 10K batches, insert_many(ordered=False)

steps.name: Verify parity
steps.notes: Source count == destination count per collection and per state

steps.name: Create vector indexes
steps.notes: provider_vector_index (3072d cosine) + specialty_vector_index. DR-016: verified on every promotion.

prescriber_evaluate_care_pipeline.description: CMS Part D prescriber data: drug behavior, crosswalk enrichment, exclusion flags, specialty normalization
data_sources: CMS Part D Prescriber PUF (3.7GB CSV)

stage_1_fetch.notes: Downloads CMS Part D + OIG + SAM via DataFetcherBase

stage_2_load.notes: Parse CSV, filter by state, build provider_quality collection

quality_gate.purpose: Data validation between every pipeline stage
quality_gate.behavior: Fail fast with clear error if gate not met. Config-driven per stage. Override via documented flag.

schema_drift_detector.purpose: Detect schema changes between pipeline runs
schema_drift_detector.behavior: SHA-256 fingerprint of normalized columns+types vs admin.SchemaFingerprints. Abort pipeline on mismatch. Override for hotfixes.

fatal_alert_bridge.purpose: Ring bell on fatal pipeline errors per v4-008
fatal_alert_bridge.behavior: Local: PowerShell beep loop every 5 seconds. Cloud: Pushover webhook. Events logged to admin.BellEvents.

idempotency_manager.purpose: Skip completed stages on restart without re-running
idempotency_manager.behavior: Check output file/collection existence + hash. Deterministic upsert keys. Conditional blob upload.

traceability_matrix_manager.behavior: CI enforcement on PR and nightly. UUID-based test mapping survives renames. Audit trail per requirement.

ci_cd_conflict_detector.purpose: Detect drift between GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps enforcement logic
ci_cd_conflict_detector.behavior: Blocks deploy on conflict. Notifies legacy users. Runs in both pipelines.

api_test_updater.behavior: Only human status APIs via OpenAPI tags. Instance ID from Azure Functions env. CI blocks non-status APIs.

manifest_manager.purpose: Include MongoDB collections in project manifest (DR-021)
manifest_manager.behavior: Auto-detect collections. Add mongodb_collections section to manifest.

v4_remediations.prescriber_evaluate_care_pipeline: Replace raw requests.get with DataFetcherBase subclass calls. Replace .readall() with streaming download_blob().chunks(). Move hardcoded URLs to env/config.
v4_remediations.cloud_only_execution: prescriber_evaluate_care_pipeline.py becomes Durable Functions orchestrator. CI gate rejects 'if __name__'. Health check verifies WEBSITE_SITE_NAME.
v4_remediations.copytofrontend_fix: Atomic staged copy with metadata sidecar. Count+hash parity verification. Atomic swap. Rollback on failure. Addresses BUG-LOAD-001.

execution_rules.stage_ordering: Sequential stages (v4-001E): Assemble -> Process -> Enrich -> Embed -> Ship. Each completes before next begins. No interleaving.
execution_rules.parallel_sub_steps: Within each stage, sub-steps may run in parallel (e.g., 32 load workers, parallel index builds).
execution_rules.cloud_only: v4-001C: All workloads execute on Azure Functions, never local machine.
execution_rules.data_acquisition: v4-001D: All downloads through DataFetcherBase with ETag/SHA-256. Never raw HTTP. Stream and chunk. Never load full file in memory.

vector_search.placement: Vector indexes ONLY on frontend cluster (v3 decision). Pipeline cluster holds raw vectors, no indexes.
vector_search.scaling: Max 2M providers at 3072d before evaluating external vector DB. Monitor RAM at 80% threshold.

parquet.partitioning: By state, year. Optional NPI prefix for large states.
parquet.role: Immutable audit source. Cold-start recovery to MongoDB.

azure_blob.role: Intermediate file storage (downloaded ZIPs, extracted CSVs)

mongodb_pipeline.role: Operational mutable state during pipeline execution. DR-020: ZERO admin state.

mongodb_frontend.role: Production serving. All admin state. All vector indexes. 24/7 uptime.
